controls.regle: Authentication for all human access is delegated to a central identity provider, with MFA enabled.
controls.verification: Verify the application's authentication configuration: delegation to the central IdP (no local application account outside the procedure), MFA required for all human access.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the authentication configuration + IdP MFA policy.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = IdP delegation + MFA proven ; partial = delegation without systematic MFA ; non-compliant = local authentication or no MFA
actions_audit: Inspect the authentication configuration (code + platform console); attach the capture.
Test access without MFA: it must be denied; document the result.
If gap: formulate the remediation action (IdP delegation, MFA activation).

controls.regle: No secret (key, token, password, certificate) resides in the source code, the repository history, the versioned configuration, or the delivered artifacts.
controls.verification: Run the technology profile's secrets scan on the repository's full history; verify the scan's integration in CI with a blocking failure.
controls.preuve_attendue: Scan report (0 findings) on the full history + CI pipeline configuration.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = clean scan + active CI gate ; partial = clean scan without a CI gate ; non-compliant = ≥ 1 active secret detected
actions_audit: Run the secrets scan on the full history; attach the report.
Verify the pipeline fails when a canary secret is introduced; attach the proof.
If gap: revoke/rotate the exposed secrets, purge the history, connect the vault.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V13.3.1 (gestion des secrets) + V13.2.1/V13.2.3 (authentification de service)

controls.regle: Application secrets reside in a central vault; rotation ≤ 90 days; access log active.
controls.verification: Inventory the application secrets and their location; verify the rotation policy and the activation of the vault's access log.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of secrets + capture of the rotation policy + access log excerpt.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = vault + rotation ≤ 90 days + active log ; partial = vault without governed rotation ; non-compliant = secrets outside the vault
actions_audit: List the secrets consumed by the application and their location; attach the inventory.
Verify the last rotation date of each secret; attach the capture.
If gap: migrate to the profile's vault and schedule the rotation.

controls.regle: Applications authenticate via runtime identity (no static application secret) everywhere the platform allows it.
controls.verification: Identify the inter-service authentications; verify the use of runtime identities rather than static secrets, and justify each exception.
controls.preuve_attendue: Map of inter-service authentications with the mechanism used.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = runtime identities used wherever possible, exceptions justified ; partial = mixed with no justification ; non-compliant = static secrets widespread
actions_audit: Map the service-to-service links and their authentication mode.
For each remaining static secret, require justification of platform impossibility.
If gap: switch to the profile's runtime identity.

controls.regle: Authorization is based on documented roles (RBAC); access is reviewed at least every 6 months.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a documented roles/permissions matrix and the trace of the last access review (< 6 months).
controls.preuve_attendue: RBAC matrix + dated minutes of the last access review.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = matrix up to date + review < 6 months ; partial = matrix without a recent review ; non-compliant = no role model
actions_audit: Request the roles/permissions matrix; verify its correspondence with the actual configuration.
Verify the date and scope of the last access review.
If gap: establish the matrix and schedule the periodic review.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V8.2.1/V8.3.1 (autorisation au niveau fonction, appliquée en couche de confiance)

controls.regle: Technical accounts are dedicated, not shared, granted minimal privileges, and distinct from human accounts.
controls.verification: Inventory the technical accounts used; verify dedication/non-sharing/least privilege and the absence of human use of these accounts.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of technical accounts with owner, scope, and privileges.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = dedicated accounts with minimal privileges ; partial = dedicated but over-privileged accounts ; non-compliant = shared accounts
actions_audit: List the technical accounts and cross-check against the usage logs.
Verify the granted privileges against the actual need.
If gap: create dedicated accounts and reduce the privileges.

controls.regle: External access (partners, service providers) goes through invited federated identities; no local account outside the procedure.
controls.verification: Inventory the active external accesses; verify their federation and the existence of a creation/revocation procedure.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of external identities + associated management procedure.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% federated with a procedure ; partial = federated without a revocation procedure ; non-compliant = external local accounts
actions_audit: Extract the list of external identities and their creation method.
Verify the revocation procedure (service provider's departure).
If gap: migrate to the profile's invited identity federation.

controls.regle: Sensitive operations (authentication, elevation, access to protected data) are logged in a tamper-proof, timestamped manner.
controls.verification: Verify the presence of the sensitive events in the logs, their timestamping, and the write protection (immutability/retention).
controls.preuve_attendue: Log excerpts of the sensitive operations + immutability configuration.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = events complete, timestamped, protected ; partial = logged without protection ; non-compliant = sensitive operations not logged
actions_audit: Replay a sensitive operation in a test environment and find its trace.
Verify the retention/immutability policy of the audit logs.
If gap: instrument the missing events and protect the storage.

controls.regle: Public clients (browser application, mobile) carry no static secret; authentication relies on short-lived tokens obtained via a flow adapted to public clients (PKCE or server-side intermediary).
controls.verification: Inspect the delivered client artifacts (bundle, application) for embedded keys/secrets; verify the authentication flow used and the token lifetime.
controls.preuve_attendue: Analysis of the client artifact (0 secrets) + description of the observed authentication flow.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 0 embedded secrets + compliant public client flow ; partial = compliant flow but long-lived tokens ; non-compliant = static secret embedded client-side
actions_audit: Analyze the delivered bundle/application for secrets (scan + inspection); attach the report.
Document the public client's actual authentication flow; attach the capture.
If gap: remove the secret, revoke it, switch to a short-lived token flow (PKCE/server-side intermediary).
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V13.3.1 (gestion des secrets, 4.0.3 V2.10) + V7.2.2 (jetons dynamiques, jamais de secret statique) + V10 (OAuth et OIDC)
